heatmap.ranking.partialHint: Up to {{count}} unseen candidates may outrank retained rows
statements.evidenceNote: table: latest interval at cursor · heatmap/spark: selected range · candidates: top time ∪ calls · SQL: capped detail
statements.filterHint: Searches the collected candidate set only. Use field=value and *glob*; queryid uses the full signed decimal value; lazy SQL text is excluded.
statements.matrix.seriesUnavailable: series not retained for this statement
statements.matrix.title: Ranked history
statements.lens.regression.reason: comparable baseline deltas are not projected
statements.lens.observedSamples.reason: no proven per-statement activity/process sample relation
activity.evidenceNote: rows: point snapshot at cursor · sample lanes: selected range · fast queries may be missed
activity.filterHint: Searches retained rows in the selected activity snapshot; lazy query text is excluded.
activity.pointEvidence: One pg_stat_activity observation at the cursor. Short queries between samples are not evidence of absence.
activity.processEvidence: CPU and disk values use one unique same-snapshot PID candidate. The relation remains best-effort; process lifetime is preserved in Entity Detail.
activity.samplingEvidence: Observed snapshot coverage only — not ASH and not an exact attribution of query cost.
activity.locks.empty: No retained waiter/blocker lanes in this snapshot
activity.lensNote.overview: State, wait class and duration share the same activity snapshot.
activity.lensNote.duration: Durations are snapshot_ts − start timestamp; null start time stays unknown.
activity.lensNote.replication: Replica fields require a same-snapshot walsender PID association.
activity.lens.xidHorizon.reason: backend_xmin and horizon attribution are not projected in this view
activity.matrix.seriesUnavailable: No retained observed samples for this backend
activity.matrix.group.samples: Observed point samples — no continuity claim
activity.matrix.locks.title: Waiter → blocker evidence
activity.matrix.locks.note: Bounded lock edges observed at the cursor; query age is not lock age.
plans.evidenceNote: table: latest interval at cursor · heatmap: selected range · attribution is fork-specific and best-effort
plans.filterHint: Searches retained plan candidates only; plan text remains capped lazy detail.
plans.attributionUnavailable: No fork attribution metadata is available
plans.timeline.empty: No retained plan call interval in this snapshot
plans.lensNote.time: Calls and mean time are counter deltas for the selected interval.
plans.lensNote.io: Shared hit/read values are interval deltas, not plan-node I/O attribution.
plans.lensNote.rows: Rows are emitted-plan counter deltas; no cardinality estimate comparison is claimed.
plans.lens.compare.reason: two bounded plan trees and a typed diff contract are not available
host.evidenceNote: host metrics and process rows are separate evidence scopes · heatmap: selected range · panel: host-only pressure
host.filterHint: Searches retained process rows; host metrics, cgroups and process totals are never added together.
host.lens.network.reason: network device counters are not collected by the public host projection
host.lens.filesystems.reason: filesystem capacity and mount identity are not collected by the public host projection
hostEvidence.scopeGuard: {{cpus}} logical CPUs · kernel {{kernel}} · host values are not summed with process/cgroup rows
hostEvidence.note.pressure: Load per CPU is runnable demand; PSI I/O is stalled time. Neither is utilization.
hostEvidence.note.cpu: CPU rate is interval evidence and may exceed one core; host capacity stays separate.
hostEvidence.note.memory: RSS and cache fields describe different ownership; do not sum overlapping process and cgroup scopes.
hostEvidence.note.disk_io: Storage-accounted process bytes are not PostgreSQL buffer reads and may omit cached I/O.
hostEvidence.note.cgroup: Cgroup limits explain throttling and OOM pressure only when the collector publishes that scope.
hostEvidence.note.processes: Rows are one process snapshot; use lifetime identity before relating the same PID across time.
hostEvidence.note.data_quality: Gaps, gated sources and resource limits are evidence, not visual noise.
tables.evidenceNote: table counters: latest interval · size: point value · growth: unavailable without comparable history · vacuum: independent nearest snapshot
tables.filterHint: Searches retained table candidates by database, schema and relation; dependencies are not projected.
tables.lens.dependencies.reason: dependency graph evidence is not projected
tables.lens.sizeGrowth.reason: comparable retained size snapshots are not projected
tableEvidence.snapshotPending: Resolving the nearest vacuum snapshot; no table-to-vacuum join is claimed here.
tableEvidence.snapshotDisclosure: Vacuum snapshot {{snapshot}} · cursor delta {{delta}}. This panel is independently resolved and is not joined to the Tables frame.
tableEvidence.noActiveVacuum: No active vacuum row in this snapshot; this is not lifetime history.
indexes.evidenceNote: index counters: latest interval · size: point value · growth: unavailable without comparable history · table context: same snapshot relation
indexes.filterHint: Searches retained index candidates; duplicate definitions and invalid-build state are not projected.
indexes.lens.duplication.reason: normalized index definition and predicate comparison are not projected
indexes.lens.invalidBuild.reason: indisvalid, indisready and build-progress evidence are not projected
indexes.lens.sizeGrowth.reason: comparable retained size snapshots are not projected
indexEvidence.sameSnapshotOnly: Index and table are related by database and relation OID only at this snapshot.
indexEvidence.note.usage: Scan counts show observed use, not whether the planner should have chosen the index.
indexEvidence.note.io: Index buffer reads may be served from the OS page cache; they are not physical disk I/O.
indexEvidence.note.size: Current size is a point value; this lens does not claim growth.
indexEvidence.note.unused: No observed scans in the window is not proof the index is safe to drop.
indexEvidence.note.table_context: Table writes, scans and vacuum state give context without claiming index causality.
vacuum.evidenceNote: active vacuum: point snapshot · phase/progress: current process · table context: same snapshot · no PID history join
vacuum.filterHint: Searches active vacuum rows; a missing row means not observed at this snapshot, not never vacuumed.
vacuum.lens.throughput.reason: comparable phase deltas and worker lifetime continuity are not projected
vacuum.lens.blockers.reason: a proven vacuum-to-lock blocker relation is not projected
vacuum.lens.history.reason: PID + relation OID does not prove one vacuum worker across snapshots
vacuum.lens.wraparound.reason: vacuum progress does not publish XID or MXID wraparound evidence
vacuumEvidence.lifetimeWarning: Point evidence only: PID reuse prevents a safe cross-time vacuum history.
vacuumEvidence.tableContext: The owning table relation is temporal: datid + relid + snapshot timestamp.
events.evidenceNote: Signals: bounded typed facts in the selected range · heatmap: visual correlation, not causality · identity/evidence quality stays explicit
events.filterHint: Prepared lenses apply a machine event-family filter while this field is empty. A typed user filter overrides it.
events.lens.configChanges.reason: no typed configuration-change source is published
eventsSignals.title: Signals
eventsSignals.error: Failed to load bounded event evidence.
eventsSignals.empty: No retained signal matches this lens; this is not proof that the event did not occur.

dock.detail.historyUnavailable: History is not available for this projection
dock.detail.rawProjectedOnly: Raw typed source rows are not exposed yet. This is the bounded projected point response, not raw collector evidence.
